title: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings to Hold Conference Call on Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

# Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings to Hold Conference Call on Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_27be90118c36ba579f120406c52a6474/nclhltd/news/2026-10-15_Norwegian_Cruise_Line_Holdings_to_Hold_Conference__833.pdf) October 15, 2026 4:15pm EDT


MIAMI, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) (together with NCL Corporation Ltd., “Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings” or the “Company”) announced today it will report third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 6:30 a.m. Eastern Time with a conference call and webcast to discuss results at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


The conference call will be webcast via the Company’s Investor Relations website,[https://www.nclhltd.com/investors](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sD-i5oAVfybF2CSIVPvUu3QjHRBSPHlyR-kNwcMRe1r9HxWgSf0PObxHLqzxMhpjmFkqjSZapQRb1zYfarXzKUskfvWaDZU5EAGL_IJxkdB0pany79ifjtKz26Dbbw1M) . A replay of the webcast will be available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8FDt67ZXUAfKkBWVLk8deBSlGKTlVs74L4s19GzX2Zmn6KrAXjWetP33E-GaFzrYVGmTRuYcRuDhAl-EpRqKebGbGSNeY7SP3IZmOReg9VA=) on the Company’s website for 30 days following the call.


**About Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd.**


Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a leading global cruise company which operates Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. NCLH has a combined fleet of 33 ships and approximately 72,000 berths, excluding two ships under long-term charter to third parties, and offers itineraries to nearly 700 destinations worldwide. NCLH expects to add 16 additional ships across its three brands through 2037, which will add ~43,000 Berths to its fleet. To learn more, visit[www.nclhltd.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sDuWLpDo7WYjGO2l8G5G-7LtTyp2UxVSeme4Qozq-CblZAjThl-ck0I6-XnUNNj9iMdTVOi7NuQubs1-EjHFZA==) .
